get.description:
Returns the Terms of Service agreements the authenticated user has on file. Each entry records the version agreed to and when. Most users only have one agreement per product, but if the ToS is updated and the user re-agrees a new entry is added.

Results are paginated with the standard `page[number]` / `page[size]` parameters; the response uses the standard `{data, meta}` JSON:API envelope.

By default this returns agreements for **all** products the user has agreed to. Pass the `product_type` query parameter to scope the result to a single product.

parameters.description: Optional filter. Omit to list the user's agreements for **every** product (branded_calling and number_reputation); pass a value to return only that product's agreements.
parameters.name: product_type

get.summary: List the calling user's Terms of Service agreements

get.description: Retrieve a single ToS agreement record. Returns `404` if the agreement does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user.
get.summary: Get a Terms of Service agreement by id

post.description:
Records the authenticated user's agreement to the current Branded Calling ToS. No body required. Idempotent - re-calling after agreement is a no-op and returns the existing agreement.

This is a prerequisite for activating Branded Calling on any enterprise (`POST /enterprises/{id}/branded_calling`); without an agreement, activation returns `403`.
post.summary: Agree to the Branded Calling Terms of Service

get.description: Returns the available Terms of Service agreements (product, current version, terms URL, effective date). Omit `product_type` to return all products; pass it to scope to one.

parameters.description: Optional product filter. Omit to return info for all products.
parameters.name: product_type

post.description:
Records the authenticated user's agreement to the current Phone Number Reputation ToS. No body required. Idempotent.

Prerequisite for using any of the `/v2/.../reputation/*` endpoints.
post.summary: Agree to the Phone Number Reputation Terms of Service

get.description:
Returns whether the authenticated user has agreed to the current Terms of Service for the product given by `product_type`. Used during onboarding to decide whether to prompt the user with the ToS dialog before continuing.

`agreement_required: true` means the user has not yet agreed (or has agreed to an outdated version) and must agree before using that product's endpoints.

parameters.description: Which product's ToS to check. Defaults to `branded_calling`.
parameters.name: product_type

get.summary: Get the calling user's Terms of Service status
